name: clarity-toolkit
description: Interview plans, prepare discovery questionnaires, explain confusing messages, and hand off conversations. An unofficial adaptation of selected Matt Pocock skills.

interface.longDescription: An unofficial, skills-only adaptation of five Matt Pocock workflows. Sharpen requirements through interviews, draft questionnaires, re-explain confusing messages, and prepare grounded handoffs. Internal instructions are English; responses follow your language. No external services or runtime scripts are required.
defaultPrompt: Interview me to clarify my requirements.
Turn the questions I need answered into a questionnaire.
Prepare a handoff from this conversation.
